title: How Bastion Twin Works
subtitle: Understand the workflow, practical value, and best way to use the platform

overview.title: What This Platform Is
overview.body: Bastion Twin is an interactive cyber-defense planning workspace for SME teams. It simulates realistic login/API attacks, lets you tune controls in real time, and converts results into implementation-ready actions.

compose.title: 1. Compose Scenario
compose.body: Set attack type, intensity, target surface, and business profile.

run.title: 2. Run Live Simulation
run.body: Launch the scenario and monitor traffic, map origins, and threat levels.

tune.title: 3. Tune Defenses
tune.body: Enable/disable controls and immediately observe security KPI changes.

compare.title: 4. Compare Baseline vs Hardened
compare.body: Capture snapshots and measure what improved after hardening.

report.title: 5. Export Action Plan
report.body: Generate bilingual reports to share with engineering and leadership.

risk.title: Risk Visibility
risk.body: See where threats are coming from and how severe the exposure is.

decision.title: Decision Confidence
decision.body: Test defense combinations before changing production policies.

roi.title: Measurable ROI
roi.body: Use comparison metrics to justify security investments with evidence.

alignment.title: Team Alignment
alignment.body: Share a common view with Ops, Security, and Management using the same report.

quickStart.title: How To Use This Website (Quick Start)

steps.one: Open Scenario Composer and save one scenario for your environment.
steps.two: Run it from Workspace and record a baseline snapshot.
steps.three: Move to Defense Lab and apply/tune controls.
steps.four: Capture a hardened snapshot and review Comparison View.
steps.five: Generate recommendations and export report in tk/en.

tips.title: Best Practice
tips.body: Re-run your core scenarios monthly or after major auth/policy changes. Track trend improvements over time.
